proof_attempt_summary: The run derived exact low-intensity and zero-atom results, a finite truncation/rounding reduction, a corrected semialgebraic fixed-design separation lemma, and a complete T=3 early-kill certificate with an explicit integral incumbent and branch record. It collapsed at D0.5 because these results were judged incremental and the field-level total uniform certificate through equality contacts remained open; independently, the randomized Gaussian-bridge proof did not control escaping rescaled interval endpoints, so the bank preserves that soundness gap rather than claiming closure.
tldr: A staggered multiplicative panel with rare Poisson totals turns the Moreau--Kastler equation (3.14) proportional-effect setup into a discrete minimax confidence problem. The contribution derives the exact low-intensity deterministic value and all optimizers, proves a strict first-order gain from randomized interval kernels, prices the stronger all-untreated-zero fallback separately, and relates both procedures to the efficient high-intensity Gaussian limit. At every fixed algebraic observed design, stratum-closure continuations reduce strict coverage and risk comparisons, including one-sided membership-switch limits, to finitely many critical-component values. The mandatory \(T=3\), \(\alpha=1/20\), \(\kappa=1/100\), \(K=2\), \(h=1/100\) test is discharged by a globally share-uniform all-\(\Theta\) primal and a complete finite integer lower tree, with a stored integral incumbent and certified gap \(1/20\). The remaining open question is total finite synthesis over arbitrary compact intensity ranges at zero-margin coverage and target-endpoint contacts.
gap: Regular staggered-PPML work supplies the proportional target and high-information inference, while exact discrete interval work treats scalar families or finite-prior Monte Carlo approximations. Schafer and Stark (2009) do not provide deterministic finite termination or continuum honesty, and Andrews, Cheng, and Guggenberger (2020) do not turn qualitative drifting subsequences into a finite verifiable cover.
fill: The paper joins exact low-count values and a high-count efficiency bridge to a finite certificate format whose accepted rational data prove global coverage, a conservative upper risk, and an integrality-preserving lower bound with an explicit error ledger.
